definitions.explanation: A category of mental health conditions characterized by anxiety, obsessive thoughts, phobias, or compulsive behaviors, without loss of contact with reality. The traditional Japanese psychiatric term, now partially replaced by more specific diagnostic labels.

examples.japanese: {神経症|しんけいしょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{診断|しんだん}→診断：04209_shindan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{神経症|しんけいしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Intense stress can be a cause of neurosis.

examples.japanese: {神経症|しんけいしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{適切|てきせつ}→適切：01621_tekisetsu⟧な⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}する→改善する：26828_kaizensuru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Neurosis often improves with appropriate treatment.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧ (nerve, nervous) and {症|しょう} (condition, disease). Historically a broad category in Japanese psychiatry that included anxiety disorders, obsessive-compulsive disorder, and phobias. Modern psychiatry increasingly uses more specific terms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {神経症|しんけいしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧: symptoms of neurosis
- ⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧{神経症|しんけいしょう}: anxiety neurosis
- {強迫|きょうはく}{神経症|しんけいしょう}: obsessive-compulsive neurosis (now more commonly {強迫性|きょうはくせい}⟦{障害|しょうがい}→障害：03228_shougai⟧)
- {神経症|しんけいしょう}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧: neurotic

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ノイローゼ→ノイローゼ：08831_noirooze⟧: neurosis — loanword from German (Neurose), commonly used in everyday conversation
- ⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦{障害|しょうがい}→障害：03228_shougai⟧: anxiety disorder — the modern clinical replacement term
- ⟦{精神|せいしん}{障害|しょうがい}→精神障害：26907_seishinshougai⟧: mental disorder — a broader category
- ⟦{心身症|しんしんしょう}→心身症：30650_shinshinshou⟧: psychosomatic disorder — physical symptoms caused by psychological stress

USAGE:
In everyday Japanese, ⟦ノイローゼ→ノイローゼ：08831_noirooze⟧ is often used more casually (⟦{育児|いくじ}→育児：03998_ikuji⟧⟦ノイローゼ→ノイローゼ：08831_noirooze⟧, "parenting neurosis"), while {神経症|しんけいしょう} appears in clinical and formal contexts.
